metadata.schema_purpose: Engineering reference fixture, not a required production serialization format
metadata.origin: Synthetic analytic/numerical construction; no OEM or confidential data
metadata.verification_status: Algebraic identities, independently reduced 1D inverse reference calculations and selected bound checks performed; no hardware or external-simulator validation performed
metadata.scope: Balanced sinusoidal three-phase steady-state fundamental model
metadata.convention: Amplitude-invariant Park; d axis PM-aligned; dq quantities phase peak; p=pole pairs

declared_operating_domain.interpretation: Synthetic allowed-operating-domain restrictions, not measured demagnetization or rotor-strength limits

loss_voltage_approximation: Ideal command-to-terminal voltage mapping (delta_v_inv=0) plus explicit synthetic energy-loss surrogate. Not a detailed semiconductor drop/deadtime model.
default_policy: Minimum Ipk^2 subject to shaft torque, voltage, current, declared domain; then evaluate DC acceptance. Do not intentionally raise losses to meet charging cap.
